title: FPS Test Please Give Honest Feedback
author: broker415
selftext:
If you’re having trouble with art for your ai assisted game, always remember the unity asset store is your best friend

Made with Cursor + Unity in a weekend 👾🕹️🤫

comments.author: FilipeDM
comments.body: Very good. What tool did you use to create this map?

replies.author: broker415
replies.body: Free asset pack for the buildings then places them by hand in Unity terrain editor over the span of like 8 hours lol

replies.author: broker415
replies.body:
In hindsight if I were to do it again I would give Fable 5 screenshots of the concepts I wanted from certain existing maps 

(cramped shipping container cqb with long lanes and odd corner angles to break up the constant run and gun flow) 

And then have fable 5 use unity to place the assets for me

comments.author: Damaged_Gadget
comments.body:
This isn't A.I it's stolen assets

What part did you actually create?

replies.author: broker415
replies.body: They aren’t stolen lol it’s unity asset store

comments.author: SpaghettiMan247
comments.body: Looks good, aim down sights should be closer to the sight without a visible rifle stock.
